description: Store a value under a key. Costs $0.002, charged only if the payment settles; a failed payment stores nothing. Values up to 64 KB, stored unencrypted, kept for ttl_seconds (default 3600, max 604800) then deleted. Overwrites an existing key and bumps its seq. The write becomes visible once the payment has settled. Returns the box id, which is also what free reads need. A box is a namespace of keys. Omit it on a paid call to use your own wallet's box (the call returns its id). Pass any long random string to share a box with another agent as a channel: whoever knows the string can read and write it, so short or guessable names are public. Pass a box_... id returned by an earlier call to address that box directly. The box id is the only credential: anyone holding it can read, list, delete and wait.
name: put
